createPayload.title: MSC-C2 — Bind compiled tracks to the already loaded MPFB patient
createPayload.objective: Convert the published CompiledMotionClipV1 into a THREE.AnimationClip and register/play it on the existing supine patient mixer with exact skeleton and scene identity checks.
createPayload.knownGood: EXECUTION PACKAGE: Read docs/openclinxr/humanoid-motion-delegation-2026-09-14/handoff.md and docs/openclinxr/humanoid-motion-delegation-2026-09-14/cards/c2.json before editing. The live BothyBoard card overrides either artifact on conflict. The existing playManifestMotionClip can select a named clip on a mixer, but no path converts CompiledMotionClipV1 tracks onto the loaded MPFB graph. The target mixer root is the already loaded patient_robert_hayes_v1 humanoid. At a pinned mid-clip time, at least one named upper-body bone must differ from bind pose by the contract epsilon; property bindings resolve; clip name equals authored responseClip; scene root and SkinnedMesh counts do not increase. Read docs/openclinxr/humanoid-motion-delegation-2026-09-14/handoff.md and this card JSON before editing. The live card is authoritative. Preserve all nine laws in the handoff. Primary runtime input is CompiledMotionClipV1; read back the sidecar GLB to cross-check clip identity and driven-bone set. Loading the bake GLB as a second figure is an explicit failed treatment.
createPayload.outOfScope: No sidecar GLB parenting, second mixer/root, dummy skeleton, physician stand-in, UI-XR touch wiring, or broad posture policy change.
createPayload.notTested: Visual quality, clinical validity, Quest readiness, or all motion primitives.
